import os
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545741/attempts/24c6b32aa5ef47bea0ad877ddcf721da/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Separator lines span the full width or height; remaining colors are
    # background and the sparse markers.
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    # The separator color is the color shared by full-width separator rows.
    sep_color = grid[sep_rows[0]][0] if sep_rows else None
    top = [0] + [r + 1 for r in sep_rows]
    bottom = sep_rows + [h]
    left = [0] + [c + 1 for c in sep_cols]
    right = sep_cols + [w]
    bg = next(v for row in grid for v in row if v != sep_color)
    marker = next(v for row in grid for v in row if v != sep_color and v != bg)
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(top, bottom):
        row_out = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(left, right):
            n = sum(grid[r][c] == marker for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            row_out.append(1 if n >= 2 else bg)
        out.append(row_out)
    return out
'''
